name: near miss — 'Concentration:' must not be answered as the school name

spec_quote: A label ending with "Major" / "Minor" / "Concentration" (optionally followed by ":") ... is NOT the school-name question.
why: The spec only says a Concentration label is not the school question; it does not say whether it maps to the field of study (as 'Major' does) or to unknown, so the required value is underspecified.
